All risks insurance Provides cover against accidental physical loss or damage to specified items because of any cause which is not specifically excluded from the policy. This includes theft, fire and accidental damage including riot and strikes. It is important that the insured lists the items covered and their respective values / sum insured. Burglary Theft of insured property by any person or persons using violent and forcible means of entry into or exit from the premises where such property is kept, without permission from the owner, person or persons to whom such property is legally entrusted or kept on behalf. This section extends to cover the insured against losses occurring without forcible or violent entry or exit from Insured premises. Electronic Equipment The section of the policy covers: Material Damage Accidental physical loss or damage to electronic equipment is due to fire, theft, electrical derangement or any other sudden and unforeseeable damage to the equipment not otherwise excluded in the policy. Reinstatement of data Reinstatement of data and storage media for data caused by a defined event or circumstances covered under the material damage section above. Increased Cost of Working The additional expenditure necessarily and reasonably incurred by the Insured includes costs and expenses for hiring of alternative equipment following loss or damage to the electronic equipment covered under the material damage section above. Money Covers loss of money within the premise (during & outside working hours), on transit, with authorized staff as well as damage to safe. Plate Glass This section covers accidental loss or damage to plate glass up to the insurance value. Cover can be arranged for cabinet glass, display glass, signs and neon's, fixed glass and glass partitions on the premises. Public Liability This cover provides compensation in law arising out of: i. Bodily Injury to any person who is not a member of the Insured family or engaged in his service at the time of the injury and ii. Damage to property not belonging to the Insured or a member of the Insured family and not being in the charge or under the control of the Insured or of a person acting on behalf of the Insured arising out of or in connection with the insured business The cover does not extend to any claim arising out of contractual agreements. Goods in transit The section covers loss of or damage to property and/or goods caused by fire, theft or accidental means whilst in transit by road, rail or inland waterways. Cover extends to include temporarily storages or housing of the vehicle in the ordinary course of transit within the territorial limits. Machinery Breakdown Specialized policy that covers accidental and sudden physical damage (short circuits, overheating, lubrication failure, physical explosion) to machinery and equipment while in operation, rest, or during maintenance/installation Employers Liability Protects employers against legal and financial liabilities arising from employee claims for work-related injuries, illnesses, or deaths that are not covered under workers' compensation or similar schemes. Political violence & terrorism This section covers Acts of Terrorism, Sabotage, Riots, Strikes and Civil Commotion, Civil War, Malicious Damage, Insurrection, Revolution or Rebellion, Mutiny, Coup état or any other damage or losses caused by acts of political violence. Fidelity Guarantee It compensates the insured person against direct pecuniary (financial) loss by any means like forgery, embezzlement, theft carried out by the insure employees while carrying out their duties. In this case it will cover theft by the drivers and turn boys. Group personal accident (GPA) & work injury benefits act (WIBA) a) Work Injury Benefit Act (WIBA) It is an employee benefits cover that lifts the employer financial obligation under the Work Injury Benefit Act to compensate employees injured out of and in the course of employment. The insurance cover includes: Loss of Life and Disability. Cost of Medical Care. Cost of Rehabilitation. Cost of Wages for the injured employee. Benefits to dependents of employees that have lost life due to work related accidents. b) Group Personal Accident (GPA) Covers employees against accidental loss of life or disability arising out of accident whilst on duty or pleasure on a 24-hour basis. The benefits provided for both WIBA and GPA are outlined as follows: Benefits Accidental Death - 8 Years Earnings Permanent Total Disablement (PTD) - 8 Years Earnings subject to continental scale Temporary Total Disablement (TTD) - Weekly Earnings up to a maximum of 104 weeks Medical expenses Kshs 100,000/- per person Funeral expenses Kshs 30,000/=per deceased employee Occupational diseases up to a maximum of Kshs 4,000,000 The benefits payable under WIBA and Occupational diseases is based on the provision of Work Injury Benefits Act, Chapter 13 of 2007 Laws of Kenya Sanlam Allianz SME insurance Product Beneﬁts Comprehensive risk protection - Bundled product thus simpliﬁes management and reduces gaps in protection.
